task.title: Implement Pantheon cron workflows through upstream OpenClaw integration
task.next: Cron workflows dispatched: All 4 workflows (ingest/review/retrain/deploy) verified and ready. Python syntax validated (py_compile), 8/8 unit tests passing, smoke tests 4/4 PASS. Integration with OC-001, OC-003, REG-002 confirmed. Ready for downstream use by RS-001, RS-002.
task.summary_zh: 把 ingest、review、retrain、deploy 做成 Pantheon 的受治理 cron workflow，底層再接 upstream OpenClaw。
task.review_notes_zh: OC-002 實作完整且所有測試通過。四個工作流程已通過整合驗證：ingest 製造受治理的 research_package、review 產生 approval_request（政策實施）、retrain 排放 registry_submission、deploy 正確路由通過 REG-002 推昇門。所有依賴滿足。授權派送。

handoffs.message: Implemented services/control-plane/cron/ with governed ingest/review/retrain/deploy workflow definitions, local OpenClaw dispatch envelopes, WorkflowHandoff validation, and a deploy path that routes through REG-002 PromotionGate. Verified with python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/cron -p 'test_*.py', python3 services/control-plane/cron/smoke_test.py, and python3 -m py_compile services/control-plane/cron/*.py. Remaining follow-up: replace the smoke-test runtime pin with the first real upstream release tag/commit when the transport wiring is finalized.
